explication: PrestaShop is a PHP e-commerce platform serving customers through a storefront and merchants through an administrative back office. Its principal customer workflow is browsing/searching a catalog and viewing products; the back office supports importing catalog data and configuring search engines. The README also documents payment-service support, localization, and extension through modules and themes. Several core domain files and UI subsystems appear in the tree or SOURCE INDEX without implementation excerpts, so their internal links are omitted where evidence is unavailable.
